decisionsTitle: «Ziua cursei» → «Declarații»: every signed declaration of the race on one page, in «Prezența»'s folds, for the organizers alone — and no identity document on it
decisionsSection:
**What was there.** A signed declaration was read one registration at a time: the registration's own page draws it — the typed name in the hand, a minor's two signers (§330), «pe hârtie, înregistrată de …» (BR-REQ-037-07), the version, the fingerprint (§556) — and links `GET /api/admin/registrations/[id]/declaration`, which renders its PDF for whoever reads the participant list (`canReadRegistrations`, §289) and writes `registration.declaration_downloaded` to the trail (§324). On race day an organizer who wanted to see who had signed, and how, opened the registrations one by one.

**Decision.**

1. **A seventh tab, «Declarații»** (“Declarations”), last in «Ziua cursei», after «Jurnal», at `/admin/checkin/declaratii` — one spelling in both languages, like `jurnal`; a static segment beside `[code]`, which it can never be (a desk code holds no «I»). **The Organizer's, the Administrator's and the Superadministrator's only**, by a predicate of its own, `canReadRaceDayDeclarations`, written as `canReadRegistrations` (one question, one predicate, §953): moving who reads the list moves this with it. A page of every declaration names every person of the race beside how, when and by whom their signature was taken — the list those three read already —, while the desk's other roles see one runner at a time, a name, a state and a number (§67, `AGENTS.md` §15.11). So the tab is not drawn for the desk Volunteer, the Redactor, Tehnic or a member; the page asserts the predicate on the server and is the 404 an unknown page gets for them, and the read refuses them (`FORBIDDEN`) (BR-REQ-060-01). It carries the chosen event like the other tabs and, with none chosen, takes the desk's default; an event the address names is read even when it is off the desk's list, so the page serves the day after too.
2. **The page.** «N declarații semnate» at the top — every real registration of the event that holds a signed declaration, whatever its state; a test registration is drawn, labelled, and never counted (§30). Below, those registrations in «Prezența»'s folds by state (§1002), each a fold with its count: «Confirmați» first and open — the desk's two folds of the confirmed read as one, since who came does not change what they signed —, then, closed, «De semnat din nou» (`PENDING_DECLARATION`: cancelled or expired after signing and restarted, owing a new signature; the one listed is from before), «Adresă neconfirmată», «Ofertă de loc deschisă», «Pe lista de așteptare» and «Anulate sau expirate» — closed here, unlike the desk's, because nothing on this page is handed out. A fold with nobody is not drawn. «Nume sau număr», a GET form like the desk's search: one to five digits are the race number the row shows (a confirmed row's, and the retired number of one that is over, §311); anything else is part of the name, blind to case and diacritics; a search opens every fold it found somebody in, and the count at the top stays the event's.
3. **A row**: the race number as the desk writes it (the event's format, §735; «—» before the confirmation, §548; struck on a row that is over), the name, «Semnată <when>» on the event's clock, the signature as the registration's page draws it — the typed name in the hand; a minor's two, the minor's and the parent's, each named (§330) —, «versiunea N», «pe hârtie, înregistrată de <colleague>» for one recorded at the desk, the fingerprint's twelve characters with the whole in its tip (§556), and two links: «Declarația (PDF)» — the existing route, so every download is still asserted and recorded as before — and «Pagina înscrierii». The state is a chip only in «Anulate sau expirate», the one fold that holds two. Inside a fold: by race number, lowest first; the rows without one after them, by name; then by id.
4. **No identity document on this list.** The page is opened at a race-day table that people stand in front of. The read never selects `id_document` nor `minor_id_document`, so no page built on it can print one: the series and number stay in the PDF — opened one at a time, each download on the trail — and on the registration's own page, as before.
5. **Reading only, and light.** Nothing on the page changes anything. One query for the event's rows whatever their number (`race-day/declarations.ts`): the event's registrations joined to their acceptances, `DISTINCT ON` the registration so each keeps its newest — the one its PDF prints —, the recording colleague by one join. The folds, the order and the search are a pure module's (`race-day/domain/declarations.ts`), the folds the desk's own `deskSectionOf` for every state but the confirmed.

The words are in both catalogues (`Admin.raceDay.declarations.*`, `Admin.raceDay.tabs.declarations`); the guide's «Ziua cursei» gains «Declarațiile semnate: «Declarații»» and the desk's first step names the tab.

**Refused.** The identity document on the page, even masked: the table at the start is public, and the PDF already holds it, one recorded download at a time. A tab for every desk role: the desk keeps its one runner at a time. A new route for the PDF: the existing one asserts the reading right and writes the trail. A press of any kind on this page: it lists; everything that changes a registration stays where it was.
changelogLine: - **«Ziua cursei» → «Declarații»** — the Organizer and the Administrators see every signed declaration of the race on one page, in the desk's folds by state with their counts: the number, the name, when, the signature (a minor's two), the version, who recorded a paper one and the fingerprint, each a tap from its PDF and its registration, searchable by name or number; no identity document on the page. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Ziua cursei», then «Declarații» / “Declarations” stands last, after «Jurnal», for the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator only (`canReadRaceDayDeclarations`, written as `canReadRegistrations`); for the desk Volunteer, the Redactor, Tehnic and a member the tab is not drawn, `/admin/checkin/declaratii` is the 404 an unknown page gets, and the read refuses with `FORBIDDEN` (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `race-day/declarations.test.ts`, `staff/roles.test.ts`, integration `race-day/declarations.test.ts`, `race-day/screens.test.ts`, `race-day/journal.test.ts`, e2e `race-day-declarations.spec.ts`.

Given «Ziua cursei» → «Declarații» for the chosen event — the desk's list, or any event the address names —, then every registration that holds a signed declaration is listed once, with its newest acceptance, in «Prezența»'s folds by state: «Confirmați» first and open; «De semnat din nou», «Adresă neconfirmată», «Ofertă de loc deschisă», «Pe lista de așteptare» and «Anulate sau expirate» closed; a fold with nobody not drawn; each fold with its count and «N declarații semnate» above in the counted forms, a test registration drawn and never counted; inside a fold by race number, lowest first, the rows without one by name, then by id; «Nume sau număr» finds a name blind to case and diacritics or the number the row shows, opens every fold it found somebody in and leaves the count the event's; one query for the rows whatever their number; both languages, at 320 pixels and on a desktop (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `race-day/declarations.test.ts`, unit `race-day/declarations.test.ts`, e2e `race-day-declarations.spec.ts`.

Given a signed declaration on «Ziua cursei» → «Declarații», then its row shows the race number as the desk shows it, the name, when it was signed on the event's clock, the typed name in the hand — a minor's two signers, the minor's and the parent's, each named —, the version, «pe hârtie, înregistrată de <colleague>» for one recorded at the desk, and the fingerprint's twelve characters with the whole in its tip, and links «Declarația (PDF)» — the existing route, which answers 200 with the PDF and records `registration.declaration_downloaded` for every download — and the registration's page; no identity document, the declarant's or the minor's, is in the page's words or markup (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: integration `race-day/declarations.test.ts`, e2e `race-day-declarations.spec.ts`.
